contamination.notes: Merged 2026-04-30 and released in zarr 3.2.0, i.e. before the 2026-06 recency threshold; chosen despite this because zarrs independently implements cast_value (a genuine cross-implementation oracle) and the spec is external (zarr-extensions). Hidden tests are the PR's own tests with two derivability edits; the differential matrix and the scale_offset reference are new.

horizon.proxy: 2 new modules (~800 non-test LOC), registry/exports, 11x11 dtype conversion matrix with 5 rounding modes and 3 range policies, scalar maps with JSON scalar encodings, exact integer arithmetic incl. uint64 beyond int64, fill-value propagation through resolve_metadata, JSON round-tripping with default elision; 25 distinct error-message contracts

evidence: https://github.com/zarr-developers/zarr-python/issues/3867 (linked issue: replace numcodecs.fixedscaleoffset with spec'd v3 codecs; 23 comments, maintainers d-v-b, maxrjones, TomAugspurger, LDeakin)
https://github.com/EOPF-Explorer/data-model/issues/134 (downstream user need cited in the issue)
https://github.com/zarrs/zarrs/pull/409 (independent Rust implementation with a zarr-python interop matrix test)
https://github.com/zarr-developers/zarr-python/pull/3774 (earlier pure-Python attempt, closed as too large)

foreign_metadata (4 invalid): unknown key, wrap on float array, bool target, NaN key for int source -> exception at open

scale_offset_reference int_decode (10): exact division / ValueError 'non-zero remainder' / 'outside the range of dtype'
